topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The walls of our room feel suddenly vast, as if the space between us has stretched into an unbridgeable distance. I watch you pack, each item placed with a precision that speaks volumes more than any words could. The city lights flicker outside, creating shadows that dance and whisper of times we won’t share anymore. I grip the edges of the countertop, my knuckles white, as I realize each moment we lose in silence is a moment we can never reclaim. The thought of you being so far, of the silence between us growing into something permanent, makes the air around me thin and hard to breathe. I clear my throat, forcing a smile, and I ask if you’ve thought about how you’ll decorate your new place, hoping the normalcy of the question will anchor us both to the present, to this room that isn’t yet empty.
